variations.name: Best shot at 200
variations.tagline: Bryant and Robinson as the guard engine, captain Vezenkov plus the Olympiacos coach, and five cheap role-jump players to pay for it.
variations.captain_note: Vezenkov at Maccabi (78%) with Milutinov out, and Bartzokas (OLY) on the same game: one big Olympiacos night pays twice.
variations.captain_plan: Captain Vezenkov on Tuesday. If he's under about 18 PIR, move the armband to Feliz (Wednesday at Beşiktaş), who starts for exactly this reason.
reasoning: The model's best squad over R12 and R13 (about 6% a round), spending all 103.3: no reason to keep credits with unlimited trades back before R14.
Bryant (17.6) is the round's biggest guard ceiling: 22.5 PIR per game over 10, at Baskonia (Hapoel 72%) then at Paris. His last 3 (15.3) are a dip, not a role change.
Coach lens: Baskonia's frontcourt is gutted, so Kamenjas (PIR 22 on debut) starts at center and Hapoel's guards get to the rim against them.
Cheap upside watch drives the bench: Procida (10 → 23 minutes, Madrid's forwards hurt), Rogkavopoulos (back, 23' on Sunday), Diop (15 minutes with Booker out), Marinković (4.2).
Malcolm and Diarra are left out: Efes (35%) and Virtus (33%) are underdogs, and their prices are falling into the window.
cancel_if: If the game still lists Kamenjas at Dubai on Monday night, take Frisch (BAS, 5.5) instead and drop Marinković for Llull (4.2) to pay for it.
If Rogkavopoulos isn't in Panathinaikos's Tuesday squad, take Marinković's slot for Herrera (PRS) only if the money fits; otherwise Joksimović (BAS, 4.1).
If Bryant is listed doubtful, switch to Variation B.

players.name: Elijah Bryant
